query:
update brouillons
        set contenu = jsonb_build_object('texte', $3::text),
            destinataire_genre = $4,
            destinataire_id = $5,
            destinataire_libre = $6,
            sceau_id = $7,
            signe = $8,
            modifie_le = now()
        where id = $1 and auteur_id = $2
